profile.name: Nithish Marneni
profile.title: Embedded Software Developer
profile.bio:
Embedded Software Developer with 4+ years of experience delivering validated, production-grade software in semiconductor and systems engineering environments. Consistently reduces defect escape rates, accelerates validation cycles, and improves system reliability through Python automation and low-level Linux debugging.
Holds an M.S. in Computer Science (4.0 GPA) and a B.Tech in Electronics & Communication, bridging firmware-level hardware understanding with full-stack system software skills.
• Automated validation test harnesses at AMD, cutting manual regression time by ~40% and root-causing high-severity Linux-layer defects across multi-source log traces.
• Delivered Python automation and backend modules at Inventive Core Integrations that eliminated ~15 hours/week of manual engineering effort and improved deployment reliability.
• Comfortable working in fast-paced Agile environments and collaborating closely across hardware, validation, and software teams.
